mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place (name, description, category_id, longitude, latitude, address, creator_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{address}, #{creatorId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, category_id, longitude, latitude, address, creator_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM place WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE place SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE place SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, address = #{address}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, creator_id AS creatorId, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM place ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like pl INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = pl.post_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.status = 1

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, p.longitude, p.latitude FROM place p INNER JOIN place_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' ) ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
